summary: Unlinks node a2 from a doubly-linked list. Node fields: +0x30 holds the successor pointer and +0x34 holds the predecessor pointer. The successor's +0x34 and the predecessor's +0x30 slots are patched to bypass the node; the link head stored at this+0x2C is advanced to the node's predecessor when it pointed at a2. Returns a2, or the new head when the unlinked node was the head.

operations.description: If node a2 has a successor (a2+0x30 nonzero), set the successor's predecessor slot (successor+0x34) to node a2's predecessor (a2+0x34).
If node a2 has a predecessor (a2+0x34 nonzero), set the predecessor's successor slot (predecessor+0x30) to node a2's successor (a2+0x30).
If the link head at this+0x2C equals a2, store a2+0x34 (the node's predecessor) as the new link head at this+0x2C.
Return a2, or the new link head when the unlinked node was the this+0x2C head.
